_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Panjenengan dadi Pemain {player_id} ing Tic Tac Toe.
Gol panjenengan yaiku menang telu doro (mendhuwur, menurun, utawa diagonal) ing papan.
Nalika giliran panjenengan, panjenengan kudu milih nomer persegi (0-8) sing arep diisi tandha panjenengan sabanjure.
Contone, '[4]' ndharke tandha panjenengan ing sel tengah papan.
Minangka Pemain {player_id}, panjenengan bakal dadi '{symbol}', déné lawan panjenengan bakal dadi '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: The submitted move does not follow the correct format.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} dudu sel sing sah. Kudu antara 0 lan 8.
